title: docs(releases/v19): step 19 of the protocol migration holds two entries once #37437 lands, not only protocol-18-range-refused
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYtTDvfPQDzMbZnN5X

Filing gate: ① · Source: fleet (contract record 7189751333 on PR #37437). Release-owned path; a docs-only fix for the release seat.

reach: read at `origin/main` · evidence: read.

## What

`content/docs/releases/v19/index.mdx` lines 273–275 say step 19 of the ADR-0087 migration registry holds only `protocol-18-range-refused`. PR #37437 (#35827) adds `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/19.data-table-staged-edit-retired.ts` on step 19. Once it merges, the page understates the step.

## Expected

After #37437 merges, the v19 release page lists both step-19 entries (`protocol-18-range-refused` and `data-table-staged-edit-retired`), or describes step 19 in a way that does not enumerate a closed set.

Blocked-by: #37437
